Situation Report — Day 27 — last 2 hours

No new widespread sirens or confirmed strikes reported in the past 2 hours.
  • Diplomacy / pause: Trump announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), claiming Iran requested it and talks are “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating; Iran’s president landed in Pakistan after U.S. engagement.
  • Risk note: First 5-day pause was violated within hours. Compliance remains uncertain.
  • Air campaign & tactics: US/Israeli strikes on Iran continue. Pilot report: F‑15 encountered Iran’s “jellyfish” drone swarm when a jet was downed during Epic Fury — swarm tactics confirmed in combat.
  • Northern border (Hezbollah): Daily Hezbollah activity persists. Report: underground Hezbollah base now places entire Israel in range. Local security: man shot dead near northern town of Kabul.
  • Sea / Hormuz: Iran continues selective passage — allowing Russia, India, China while blocking others. Shipping risk remains elevated.
  • Intelligence/tech: Reuters: former PM alleges Israel smuggled Starlink into Iran — potential comms/ODIN implications.
  • Legal/political: UN inquiry accuses Israel over Gaza civilian harms. Iran warns Trump’s threats could derail Switzerland talks.
  • International moves: Pakistan mediation active; no new major deployments or sanctions reported in last 2 hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: Lebanon ceasefire holding per regional reports; some reports say US eased select Iran sanctions (monitor confirmation).
Threat assessment: escalating

  • Tactical note — drones: US F-15 pilot reported seeing a 'jellyfish' drone formation during Epic Fury before the jet was shot down. Swarm-style drones confirmed in the fight.
  • Maritime — Hormuz: Iran allows passage only for friendly states (Russia, India, China); blocks others. Reduces access for some Western-linked shipping and shifts regional energy flows.
  • Diplomacy & politics: Iran's president landed in Pakistan after talks. Iran says technical talks in Switzerland concluded successfully. Trump publicly warns Iran, criticizes NATO allies, and pressures Israel leadership.
  • Sanctions & economy: Reports that the US eased some Iran sanctions. India pivots to more Russian crude/coal amid supply shifts.
  • Communications: Reuters report alleges Israel smuggled Starlink units into Iran — potential comms/ISR implications if true.
  • 🟢 Good News: Lebanon ceasefire reportedly holding; Pakistan mediation and resumed technical talks offer a diplomatic opening.
  • Threat assessment: escalating

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Pause announced: Trump declared a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes until Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET, citing an "Iranian government request" and progress in talks.
  • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating; Iran’s president traveled to Pakistan after technical talks in Switzerland, which both sides call productive.
  • First pause violated: the initial 5-day pause (Mar 23) was followed hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

Military

  • US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian sites continue over last 48h.
  • Iranian, Hezbollah and Hamas missile/rocket counterstrikes on Israel continue daily.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah strikes daily. New reports of an underground Hezbollah base that puts all of Israel in range.
  • Air combat note: F-15 pilot reported an Iranian "jellyfish" drone swarm during Epic Fury — swarm/UAV use confirmed in multiple engagements.
  • Maritime: Iran allows Hormuz passage for Russia, India, China while restricting others. Shipping access now selectively politicized.

Diplomacy & Politics

  • Pakistan mediating between US and Iran. Swiss technical teams reported progress despite public denials.
  • Trump publicly warns Iran and threatens further action if deal is violated; rhetoric risks undermining negotiators.

International moves

  • Some US sanctions reportedly eased as part of de-escalation steps (reported by outlets).
  • Russia/India/China granted Hormuz passage — geopolitical advantage for those states.

Domestic / Other

  • Claims surfaced that Israel smuggled Starlink into Iran (political/espionage allegation).

🟢 Good News

  • Lebanon ceasefire holding. Reports of progress in technical talks and targeted sanction relief aim to reduce immediate pressure.
Threat assessment: Escalating risk; pause fragile and could break.
